changeSet.sql: UPDATE bytedesk_call_extension t1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT extension_number, is_deleted, MIN(id) AS keep_id FROM bytedesk_call_extension GROUP BY extension_number, is_deleted HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) t2 ON t1.extension_number = t2.extension_number AND t1.is_deleted = t2.is_deleted AND t1.id != t2.keep_id SET t1.extension_number = CONCAT(t1.extension_number, '_DEDUP_', t1.id)

UPDATE bytedesk_call_extension t1 SET extension_number = t1.extension_number || '_DEDUP_' || t1.id FROM ( SELECT extension_number, is_deleted, MIN(id) AS keep_id FROM bytedesk_call_extension GROUP BY extension_number, is_deleted HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) t2 WHERE t1.extension_number = t2.extension_number AND t1.is_deleted = t2.is_deleted AND t1.id != t2.keep_id

UPDATE bytedesk_call_extension SET extension_number = extension_number || '_DEDUP_' || id WHERE id IN ( SELECT ranked_id FROM ( SELECT id AS ranked_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY extension_number, is_deleted ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM bytedesk_call_extension ) ranked WHERE rn > 1 )
ALTER TABLE bytedesk_call_extension ADD CONSTRAINT uk_extension_number_deleted UNIQUE (extension_number, is_deleted)
